description: Golden analytical questions for the wide `sales` fixture. Questions written in business language first; gold SQL from the fixture DDL only; every record cross-checked against an independent second query (see tests/eval/sales_v1_verify.json).

result_equivalence_legend.set_unordered_by_columns: unordered set of rows; column-name-insensitive; numeric tolerance 1e-6
result_equivalence_legend.ordered_rows: row order is part of the answer (time series / ranking)

records.question: How many of our orders came in over the phone?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE channel = 'phone';

records.question: What is the total value of everything we've sold across every order?
records.gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(total_amount), 2) FROM orders;

records.question: What does the average person on our staff earn?
records.gold_sql: SELECT round(avg(salary), 2) FROM employees;

records.question: What kinds of products do we stock?
records.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM categories ORDER BY name;

records.question: How many products have we pulled from the catalogue?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM products WHERE discontinued = true;

records.question: What is the steepest price tag on anything in our catalogue?
records.gold_sql: SELECT max(price) FROM products;

records.question: Which kinds of products bring in the most money?
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, round(sum(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC;

records.question: How many people report to each of our managers?
records.gold_sql: SELECT m.name AS manager, count(*) AS reports FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY reports DESC;

records.question: How quickly do our suppliers deliver, on average, in each part of the world?
records.gold_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, round(avg(s.lead_time_days), 2) AS avg_lead_days FROM suppliers s JOIN regions r ON r.id = s.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY avg_lead_days;

records.question: How many different products does each brand offer?
records.gold_sql: SELECT b.name AS brand, count(*) AS products FROM products p JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY products DESC;

records.question: How much stock is sitting in each of our warehouses?
records.gold_sql: SELECT w.name AS warehouse, sum(i.quantity) AS units FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = i.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.name ORDER BY units DESC;

records.question: How much money have customers paid us through each way of paying?
records.gold_sql: SELECT pm.name AS method, round(sum(p.amount), 2) AS total FROM payments p JOIN payment_methods pm ON pm.id = p.payment_method_id GROUP BY pm.name ORDER BY total DESC;

records.question: Which of our reps have booked the most orders?
records.gold_sql: SELECT e.name AS rep, count(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON e.id = o.employee_id GROUP BY e.name ORDER BY orders DESC;

records.question: How is our customer base split across the membership levels?
records.gold_sql: SELECT lt.name AS tier, count(*) AS customers FROM customers c JOIN loyalty_tiers lt ON lt.id = c.loyalty_tier_id GROUP BY lt.name ORDER BY customers DESC;

records.question: Which product labels are pinned to the most items?
records.gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS tag, count(*) AS products FROM product_tags pt JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY products DESC;

records.question: Which discount codes have been redeemed on the most orders?
records.gold_sql: SELECT c.code AS coupon, count(*) AS uses FROM orders o JOIN coupons c ON c.id = o.coupon_id GROUP BY c.code ORDER BY uses DESC;

records.question: How much money does each part of the world bring in for us?
records.gold_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

records.question: Which of our suppliers sit behind the most sales?
records.gold_sql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, round(sum(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM suppliers s JOIN product_suppliers ps ON ps.supplier_id = s.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = ps.product_id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

records.question: How much business did each marketing campaign drive?
records.gold_sql: SELECT pr.name AS promotion, round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM promotions pr JOIN order_promotions op ON op.promotion_id = pr.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = op.order_id GROUP BY pr.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

records.question: Which product labels are attached to our best-selling merchandise by value?
records.gold_sql: SELECT t.name AS tag, round(sum(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM tags t JOIN product_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = pt.product_id GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

records.question: Which of our sales squads are pulling in the most money?
records.gold_sql: SELECT tm.name AS team, round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM teams tm JOIN employee_teams et ON et.team_id = tm.id JOIN employees e ON e.id = et.employee_id JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id GROUP BY tm.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

records.question: How well are each brand's products reviewed?
records.gold_sql: SELECT b.name AS brand, round(avg(rv.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews rv JOIN products p ON p.id = rv.product_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;

records.question: Which kinds of products sell best in Europe?
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, round(sum(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id WHERE r.name = 'Europe' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC;

records.question: Where in the world are our customers based?
records.gold_sql: SELECT co.name AS country, count(*) AS customers FROM customers c JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id JOIN countries co ON co.id = r.country_id GROUP BY co.name ORDER BY customers DESC;

records.question: How many items has each shipping company delivered for us?
records.gold_sql: SELECT ca.name AS carrier, sum(si.quantity) AS units FROM shipments s JOIN carriers ca ON ca.id = s.carrier_id JOIN shipment_items si ON si.shipment_id = s.id GROUP BY ca.name ORDER BY units DESC;

records.question: Which kinds of products cost us the most in refunds?
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, round(sum(rf.amount), 2) AS refunded FROM refunds rf JOIN returns rt ON rt.id = rf.return_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = rt.order_item_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY refunded DESC;

records.question: Which product lines are sitting on the most stock?
records.gold_sql: SELECT sc.name AS subcategory, sum(i.quantity) AS units FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id JOIN subcategories sc ON sc.id = p.subcategory_id GROUP BY sc.name ORDER BY units DESC;

records.question: Which brands move the most units?
records.gold_sql: SELECT b.name AS brand, sum(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN brands b ON b.id = p.brand_id GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY units DESC;

records.question: How much did we sell in the most recent month of trading?
records.gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(total_amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) FROM orders) - interval '30 days';

records.question: How have our monthly sales moved over the last half year?
records.gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', order_date)::date AS month, round(sum(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) FROM orders) - interval '6 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

records.question: How does the last twelve months of revenue compare with the twelve before that?
records.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN order_date > m.mx - interval '12 months' THEN 'last_12m' ELSE 'prior_12m' END AS period, round(sum(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders, (SELECT max(order_date) mx FROM orders) m WHERE order_date > m.mx - interval '24 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

records.question: How did the latest quarter's takings compare with the quarter before it?
records.gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN order_date > m.mx - interval '90 days' THEN 'latest_quarter' ELSE 'prior_quarter' END AS period, round(sum(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders, (SELECT max(order_date) mx FROM orders) m WHERE order_date > m.mx - interval '180 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

records.question: How many new customers joined us each month over the past year?
records.gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', signed_up_at)::date AS month, count(*) AS signups FROM customers WHERE signed_up_at > (SELECT max(signed_up_at) FROM customers) - interval '12 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

records.question: On a typical day this past month, how many orders come in?
records.gold_sql: SELECT round(count(*)::numeric / count(DISTINCT order_date), 2) FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) FROM orders) - interval '30 days';

records.question: How many orders did we take in each quarter of the last year?
records.gold_sql: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', order_date)::date AS quarter, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) FROM orders) - interval '12 months' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

records.question: What share of recent orders ended up cancelled in the last three months?
records.gold_sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') / count(*), 2) AS cancel_pct FROM orders WHERE order_date > (SELECT max(order_date) FROM orders) - interval '90 days';

records.question: What's the typical value of an order with us?
records.gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(total_amount) / count(*), 2) FROM orders;

records.question: What slice of our customer base is made up of enterprise accounts?
records.gold_sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'Enterprise') / count(*), 2) AS pct FROM customers;

records.question: On average, how much do we earn on each unit that goes out the door?
records.gold_sql: SELECT round(sum(line_total) / sum(quantity), 2) FROM order_items;

records.question: What portion of our revenue does each product category account for?
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, round(100.0 * sum(oi.line_total) / (SELECT sum(line_total) FROM order_items), 2) AS pct FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY pct DESC;

records.question: What kind of profit margin do we make on our products, on average?
records.gold_sql: SELECT round(avg((price - cost) / price * 100), 2) FROM products WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND price > 0;

records.question: How many orders does each of our active reps handle on average?
records.gold_sql: SELECT round(count(*)::numeric / count(DISTINCT employee_id), 2) FROM orders WHERE employee_id IS NOT NULL;

records.question: Who are our five biggest customers by how much they've spent?
records.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) AS spend FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY spend DESC, c.name LIMIT 5;

records.question: What are our ten best sellers by units shifted?
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC, p.name LIMIT 10;

records.question: Which three product categories make us the most money?
records.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, round(sum(oi.line_total), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

records.question: Rank the parts of the world we sell to from strongest to weakest revenue.
records.gold_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

records.question: Which products draw the most reviews — show the top five and keep any ties.
records.gold_sql: SELECT name, review_count FROM (SELECT p.name, count(*) AS review_count, dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC) AS dr FROM reviews rv JOIN products p ON p.id = rv.product_id GROUP BY p.name) t WHERE dr <= 5 ORDER BY review_count DESC, name;

records.question: How many active customers do we have in each segment?
records.gold_sql: SELECT segment, count(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE is_deleted = false GROUP BY segment ORDER BY customers DESC;

records.question: How much genuine revenue did each region bring in, leaving out anything cancelled or sent back?
records.gold_sql: SELECT r.name AS region, round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

records.question: How many of our orders are still in progress rather than finished or called off?
records.gold_sql: SELECT status, count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY status ORDER BY orders DESC;
